findings.detail: Mountain Parent First Lien Term Loan identifier truncates the source maturity 2031-06-27 to 2031-06-07.
Navex First Lien Revolving Loan identifier uses 2032-10-14, but the matching source row states 2031-10-14.

rationale: Class 2 review of each full matching source row decides which field is wrong. The Mountain term-loan row states 6/27/2031, so the identifier date 6/7/2031 is defective. The Navex revolving-loan row states 10/14/2031; separate Navex term-loan rows mature in 2032, showing the identifier's 10/14/2032 is a wrong sibling-instrument maturity. Both flagged mismatches are therefore source-grounded extraction defects.
